feedback:
Judged from earlier races and this candidate's contents only. Nothing here states how the candidate will perform.

The candidate is the iteration 8 design, unchanged: sensor span x = -0.05, -0.025, 0.0, 0.025, 0.05 with weights (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), kd 0.6, kp 4.0, ki 0.2, base_speed 1.5, sensor_size 0.012 and last_direction. It is the best raced design so far (323.64, up from 282.45 at span 0.04). The values are inside the contract limits, and the sensor count matches the weights.

Evidence: the span change to 0.05 raised oval finishes from 12 to 14 of 20 and cut s-bend line losses (1.00 to 0.75). Slalom losses held at 1.00. Oval steering_oscillation rose to 0.40, which is above the 0.32 threshold set in earlier reviews, so this is the one warning sign. The span 0.06 result (iteration 5) cut losses but cost finishes, so the useful span is probably between 0.04 and 0.06. Sensor_size 0.016 (iteration 6) and base_speed 1.3 (iteration 2) both lowered the score, so they stay closed. The kd gains are shrinking (kd 0.6 added +42 at span 0.04), so kd is near its useful limit.

Why approve: the design is identical to the best raced result. No variant I can justify from the evidence is certain to beat 323.64, and each untested change risks a lower score. Racing it locks in this iteration's score and gives per-track telemetry.

What to do in the next iteration, depending on the race:
- If the score holds near 323 and oval finishes stay at 14 of 20, the next single-variable test is kd 0.55 at span 0.05, to check whether the oscillation rise (0.40) comes from damping.
- If the score falls below 323.64, revert the span to 0.04 at kd 0.6 (iteration 7 design, 282.45) or test an intermediate span of about 0.045 at kd 0.6, and do not raise kd further.
- Report per-track line_loss_events, max_error and steering_oscillation, plus oval completion and completion_time, so the span effect can be separated from the damping effect.
requested_changes: Keep the iteration 8 design (span x = -0.05, -0.025, 0.0, 0.025, 0.05, kd 0.6) as the baseline. If it races at about 323, next test kd 0.55 at this span, since oval steering_oscillation rose to 0.40 (above the 0.32 threshold) and the oscillation may come from damping.

If the score falls below 323.64 or oval finishes drop below 14 of 20, revert to span 0.04 at kd 0.6 (iteration 7, 282.45), or test an intermediate span of about 0.045 at kd 0.6 (between the 0.04 and 0.05 results), keeping kd at 0.6 and not raising it above that.

Hold kp 4.0, ki 0.2, base_speed 1.5, sensor_size 0.012 and last_direction fixed. Iteration 2 (speed 1.3, score 86.8) and iteration 6 (sensor_size 0.016, score 157.9) both lowered the score, so keep these fixed to keep effects separable.
